title: Ebb and Ember in Seven Numbers
why: Fact-led listicle for people researching: temperatures, session length, group sizes, depth, price, no promises.
hook_options: Ebb and Ember in seven numbers.
The numbers guests ask about most.
caption: The numbers guests ask about most: 42 degree river in January, about 180 on the bench, 1 hour 45 minutes per session, 8 in a social, 10 in a private, $49 off-peak. And zero promises about how you'll feel. #EbbAndEmber #PortlandSauna #ColdPlunge #ColumbiaRiver

slides.headline: Ebb and Ember in seven numbers.
slides.body: The figures guests ask about most, without the sales pitch.

slides.headline: Degrees. The Columbia in January.
slides.body: Cascade snowmelt. By July it climbs to 60 to 65.

slides.headline: Degrees on the bench, give or take.
slides.body: Hot cedar, river-level windows. Ladle water on the stones if you want more steam.

slides.headline: 1 hour 45 minutes per session.
slides.body: Long enough for a few rounds of heat, cold, and rest without watching the clock.

slides.headline: Guests max in a social session.
slides.body: Small on purpose. Big enough that strangers end up talking.

slides.headline: Guests in a private session.
slides.body: The whole sauna for your group. Birthdays, reunions, a team that needs a reset.

slides.headline: Feet of river under the float.
slides.body: Real depth, real current. Throw rings on deck, buddy system in the water. When in doubt, don't go out.

slides.headline: Where off-peak social sessions start.
slides.body: Memberships run $99 to $299 a month. We want this to be a habit, not a once-a-year splurge.

slides.headline: Promises about how you'll feel.
slides.body: We give you the heat, the river, and the deck. What it means is up to you.

slides.headline: Pick your number and book.
slides.body: Social, private, or membership at ebbandember.com.
